title: Teddy bear
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='26' r='12' fill='#a0522d'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='26' r='12' fill='#a0522d'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='26' r='7' fill='#e8a87c'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='26' r='7' fill='#e8a87c'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='26' fill='#c17a3a'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='14' ry='11' fill='#f0c090'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='36' r='4' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='36' r='4' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='35' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='35' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#4a2a12'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M46 48 Q50 53 54 48' stroke='#4a2a12' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#c17a3a'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='13' ry='12' fill='#f0c090'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='70' rx='8' ry='13' fill='#a0522d' transform='rotate(25 24 70)'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='70' rx='8' ry='13' fill='#a0522d' transform='rotate(-25 76 70)'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='95' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#a0522d'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='95' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#a0522d'/>
  <!-- paw pads -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='95' r='4' fill='#f0c090'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='95' r='4' fill='#f0c090'/>
  <!-- bow tie -->
  <polygon points='50,60 42,55 42,65' fill='#e03050'/>
  <polygon points='50,60 58,55 58,65' fill='#e03050'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='3' fill='#ff6080'/>
</svg>
